name: v0.9.1-pawn-shield-diagonal
stockfish_version_line: Stockfish 18 by the Stockfish developers (see AUTHORS file)
notes: Add pawn-shield diagonal tier to early-development heuristic: prefer e-pawn (non-diagonal) over d-pawn (opens e1-a5 diagonal toward uncastled king) when both available. Falls back to d-pawn when e-pawn is already advanced. Addresses ply-5 class of king exposure in opening.
